sentence: Brown melanin is made in special pigment cells.

sentence: In skin samples exposed to UVB, cells with a cap had less DNA damage.
claim: In irradiated human skin explants, epidermal cells with supranuclear melanin caps had significantly less DNA photoproducts than cells without caps.

note: [SOURCE-READ] abstract: 'We irradiated normal human skin explants with ultraviolet B… epidermal cells with supranuclear melanin caps had significantly less DNA photoproducts (both types) than epidermal cells without supranuclear melanin caps.'
